title: Best AML and KYC identity verification platforms | Market comparison 2026
summary: A comparison of nine identity platforms on AMLR Article 22(6) pathways, credential coverage, screening and source of funds.
body_markdown:
*Last updated: 27 August 2026*


The strongest AML and KYC platforms combine 4 things: verification against authoritative sources rather than document images, sanctions and PEP screening, source of funds evidence, and an audit trail of which method verified which customer. Most cover 2 or 3.


The nine compared below are Authologic, Hopae, Persona, Shufti, Signicat, Socure, Trinsic, Trulioo and Veriff.
